description: The source presentation summarises operational experience with pit thermal-storage lids at Marstal and Dronninglund. It identifies moisture accumulation, rainwater management and heat loss as engineering concerns and describes design improvements. This is a documented design-information source for physical thermal-storage construction; it does not establish a downloadable raw monitoring series, exact test protocol or shared observations with the separate Marstal degradation-model study. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
